translation: Once the moxa hit the point, it could not but leave. From then on, whenever anyone had this disease, I would press this point for them, and it was always sore and painful to the touch; I had them go home and moxa it, and none were not cured. The point is one cun and eight fen below the floating rib of the two flanks; if one also moxaes the Baihui point it is even better.
